column1: # Skript 2.17's simple entity types (SimpleEntityData), in the order it registers them: the entity's class (in
# org.bukkit.entity), whether it's a single entity or a category of them (a super type), and the item it is, if
# any (itemTypeComparator). Taken from Skript 2.17.0's SimpleEntityData.register(). A category is also an item
# when one registered before it, of its class, is ('projectile is an arrow').
